title: Ostomy Supply Program Reduction When an Expedited Refill Shipped Late After Confirmation
content:
**Service standard - Ostomy Supply Program.** A confirmation-delay reduction applies to the charge for a refill shipped expedited at the customer's request when Larkfield was slow to ship after the customer confirmed the refill, measured in calendar days from the refill's confirmation date to its ship date.

| Days from confirmation to ship date | Delay rate |
|---|---|
| More than 10 | 20% (the larger delay rate) |
| More than 5 and at most 10 | 10% (the smaller delay rate) |
| 5 or fewer, or no confirmation date recorded | None |

The confirmation-delay rate is taken off the fee.

**Boundaries (hypothetical).** Confirmed day 0, shipped day 5: none. Shipped day 6: 10%. Shipped day 10: 10%. Shipped day 11: 20%.
